decisions.reason: The necessary NFT-attribute visibility rule is already captured by the candidate's message-662 MODIFY for random_no_referral_ticket_attribute_visibility.
The candidate already has a message-662 MODIFY requiring randomly allocated no-referral commissions to appear on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes, while retaining dashboard visibility.
Visibility of randomly allocated tickets does not change how referral counts are sourced or displayed.
The source concerns no-referral ticket and commission visibility, not public referral-count statistics.
The source does not change completed-mint counts, mint numbering, or the contract source for public mint statistics.
Ticket visibility on the leaderboard and NFT attributes does not alter the prize-draw countdown or its data source.
The source concerns reward visibility, not whether successfully minted NFTs appear in the dashboard inventory.
A runtime visibility defect does not necessarily require FAQ copy changes, and the source does not request any content revision.
Missing ticket attributes do not change the requirement to render NFT cover images or wallet media.
The source does not change the prize-pool balance statistic or the contract state from which it is calculated.
The source reports that no-referral tickets are already being sent and identifies only a presentation defect; it does not change ticket issuance, recipient, registration, or lifecycle rules.
Failure to display randomly allocated tickets does not alter their existing eligibility, probability weighting, or Chainlink VRF selection behavior.
